card.name: The word usually after "is"
card.fires_on: The word "usually" (or "usual") right after a verb like "is" when a label says what typically happens, such as a transient lab change or typical treatment. It also fires weakly on "which" and similar words in low-quality web text about civil engineering.

modes.label: Usually in clinical statements
modes.description: "usually" or "usual" describing what typically happens or is typically done in a clinical finding or treatment.
modes.example: The decrease in serum potassium is<< usually>> transient, not requiring supplementation.

modes.label: Odd words in spun web text
modes.description: Linking words such as "which" or "of" in awkward, rewritten civil engineering job text.
modes.example: is one of the most crucial benefits of<< which>> has a civil engineering job.
